summary: INGAR DOBLOUGS STIFTELSE (org. no. 991 273 174) is a foundation (STI) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-06-18. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.991 (Aktiviteter i fond/legat som støtter veldedige og allmennyttige formål). In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 525 825. CEO: Truls Reidar Gulbrandsen; board chair: Yngve Johan Slettholm; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS.
